deleteBlocked.title: {{name}} can't be deleted
deleteBlocked.text: Orders, users or branches are linked to this district. If it is deleted, they will be left without a district.
deleteBlocked.note: If you merge, all of them move to the district you choose and {{name}} is deleted. Or move the orders, users and branches to another district one by one.

merge.title: Merge district
merge.text: Everything in {{name}} moves to the chosen district, and {{name}} is deleted.
merge.targetHintFull: Only districts of {{region}}. {{name}} itself is not in the list.
merge.noTargets: There are no other districts in this region
merge.irreversibleText: {{name}} will be deleted permanently. Merging can take up to 2 minutes.

progress.title: Merging…
progress.text: {{from}} → {{to}}. Orders, users and branches are being moved and their counts re-checked.
progress.keepOpenText: It can take up to 2 minutes. Don't reload the page. If the connection drops, check the result in the Activity log.

result.title: Districts merged
result.text: {{from}} was deleted. Its orders, users and branches were moved to {{to}}.

unknown.title: Result unknown
unknown.text: No response: the connection dropped or the wait timed out. The merge may have finished on the server or been cancelled.
unknown.step1: Refresh the district list. If {{from}} is not in the list, it was merged.
unknown.step2: If {{from}} is still there, look at this district's entries in the Activity log.
unknown.note: Don't start again until the result is clear.

error.title: Could not merge
error.text: The district list was refreshed: if {{from}} is still listed, nothing was merged.
